programme.boundary: This profile routes to verified evidence records. Repositories outside this index are discovery links and are not represented as having completed the same audit.

maturity.scope: Auditable research communication, not scientific merit or peer review

projects.title: EPRV Spectrograph Landscape
projects.question: How strongly does resolving power improve the local photon-limited Doppler bound as intrinsic stellar line width changes?
projects.result: R=100,000 to 150,000 improves the controlled bound by 37.1%, 11.1%, and 2.48% for intrinsic widths of 1.0, 2.5, and 5.0 km/s; the broad-line null below 10% is not rejected.
projects.boundary: Local synthetic photon-information experiment, not an end-to-end instrument performance forecast.

projects.title: ExoLight Transit Lab
projects.question: How badly can correlated time-series noise invalidate iid transit-depth uncertainties, and can event-clustered intervals restore coverage?
projects.result: At AR(1) rho=0.8, nominal 95% iid coverage falls to 54.9% and 56.1%; event-clustered intervals reach 93.2% and 92.1%.
projects.boundary: Controlled noise-model experiment, not proof that every observed transit has AR(1) residuals or that one estimator solves all red-noise structure.

projects.title: EXOhSPEC Th-Ar Atlas
projects.question: Can a multi-exposure ladder preserve strong calibration-feature centroids better than one long exposure without degrading faint features?
projects.result: Across 7,000 strong-feature injections, pixelwise HDR lowers centroid RMSE from 0.012954 to 0.002086 pixel, an 83.9% reduction; faint-feature RMSE is unchanged.
projects.boundary: Detector-domain simulation in pixels, not an atomic identification, wavelength solution, or measured radial-velocity precision.

projects.title: Research Portfolio Evidence Registry
projects.question: Can a large research portfolio expose questions, generated results, validation, releases, and limitations in one reviewer-auditable layer?
projects.result: Seven completed upgrades are represented by one validated schema and deterministic public registry; 43 ranked repositories remain explicitly unfinished.
projects.boundary: Evidence registry, not a citation index, peer-review decision, or ranking of scientific importance.

projects.title: LATTICE Radiation Twin
projects.question: Can eight historical HST epochs distinguish calendar time from four cumulative radiation proxy components well enough to interpret individual coefficients?
projects.result: The attribution gate fails: two residual degrees of freedom, condition number 175.31, maximum VIF 4,881.4, and three coefficient sign changes under leave-one-epoch-out refits.
projects.boundary: Post hoc predictor-separability diagnostic, not a radiation-damage estimate, causal claim, or authorization to open the sealed holdout.

projects.title: Finding Earth 2.0
projects.question: When the objective is reducing planet-radius uncertainty, can a larger scalar stellar-radius score justify an indirect observation without measured covariance?
projects.result: Thirteen targets support both actions. Stellar radius has the larger own-parameter score for 10, but the indirect route wins for none at |rho| <= 0.90; Kepler-296 f needs |rho|=0.995225.
projects.boundary: Correlation-grid sensitivity analysis, not a measured joint posterior or instrument-time recommendation; exposure cost is unmodelled.

projects.title: AstroBis Small-Body Evidence
projects.question: How sensitive is a 0.05 AU and 140 m encounter screen to distance intervals, missing diameters, assumed albedo, and row-limited coverage?
projects.result: In a reviewed 7,500-row JPL CAD prefix, 586 encounters are nominally close, 396 remain close at the three-sigma maximum, and 190 nominal-close rows cross the boundary.
projects.boundary: Row-limited encounter-sensitivity audit, not MOID, PHA status, impact probability, Torino score, or hazard assessment.
